name: Deb
bio: Deb is a Dog Trainer with over 10 years of experience in the Animal Industry and 18 years of experience in Public Service. She has a Bachelor’s degree with a specialization in Animal Behaviour and has completed numerous courses in animal welfare. As a Trainer she is dedicated to helping dogs and their owners get more out of their training programs. On her days off she enjoys spending time with family, hiking and training with her own dogs.
